PNOC shall have jurisdiction, control and
management, and shall be responsible for the protection,
development and rehabilitation of the watershed areas surround-
ing the following geothermal reservations:

Tongonan Geothermal Reservation pursuant to
Presidential Proclamation No. 112;
(b) Palimpinon Geothermal Reservation pursuant to
Presidential Proclamation No. 1413;
(e) Bacon-Manito Geothermal Reservation pursuant
to Presidential Proclamation No. 2036-A; and
Other Geothermal Reservations as may be dis-
covered, identified, determined, and to be
developed by FNOC, and proclaimed by the
President of the Philippines.
To effectively accomplish this mandate, PNOC
shall exercise lurisdiction and control over the aforesaid
watershed areas including but not limited to the performance
of the following acts:
(a) Enforcement of forestry laws, rules and regulations
within said watershed areas;
(6)
Identification of areas which require immediate
rehabilitation and development;
Preparation of plans and programs for the maximum
utilization of watershed resources:
(d) Formulation and/or implementation of measures to
prevent denudation of watershed cover:
(e) Public education and information drive to create
awareness among the populace of the importance of
forests and uses of watershed areas;
(f) Promotion of the development and conservation of
existing vegetative cover:
(g) Formulation of plans and development programs for
resettlement and relocation;
Coordination with other government agencies/
instrumentalities religious and civic aroups in
undertaking forest conservation measures in water-

The provisions of existing laws, decrees,
orders, rules and regulations as are inconsistent herewith
are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 16th day of July, in
the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty seven.
bra zone to. Aque
